name: rag-evaluation-benchmark
description: A RAG evaluation workbench: benchmark Baseline / Advanced Hybrid / Advanced-Pro Adaptive / GraphRAG strategies over a knowledge base with retrieval, answer-quality, efficiency and system metrics. Angular front end, NestJS API, Postgres with pgvector.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
